text.tspan: Lu and Gao's Matrix Density Functional Theory
•The fundamental variable is the matrix density D(r), the projection of the density
operator into the subspace of the lowest N states
Subspace 𝕍 N is found by minimizing
Eigenvalue of N x N matrix H[D*(r)]
Properties of the Universal Matrix Functional F[D(r)]
Under a basis transformation L in the subspace 𝕍N, wavefunctions, projections of the density
⇝ F[D] is an analytical matrix functional [Humeniuk 2024]
⇝ F[D] has no explicit dependence on number of states N (=dim D(r)) [Humeniuk 2024]
For N=1 the F[D] reduces to the universal ground state functional F[𝛒].
Recipe for "translating" ground state F[𝛒] to multistate F[D] ⇒ reuse same Taylor coefficients
